legend: Monke likes mind-boggling functions that even a genius like him can't solve. The function is the following —

f(k,x)=∑y&x=yf(k−1,y)$$$f(k, x) = \sum_{\substack{y \& x = y}} f(k - 1, y)$$$, in other words, summation of f(k−1,y)$$$f(k - 1, y)$$$ for all y$$$y$$$ that are submask of x$$$x$$$, i.e. (y&x=y)$$$(y \& x = y)$$$.

Monke tried to write a code that finds f(k,x)$$$f(k, x)$$$ mod$$$\bmod$$$ 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$. When he runs that code, his computer catches on fire, he loses his mind and comes to you. Now, to calm him down (and to also prove you're more of a genius than him), you have to write a code that can calculate f(k,x)$$$f(k, x)$$$ modulo$$$modulo$$$ 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$, which doesn't burn Monke's computer.
input: The first line of input contains t(1≤t≤105)$$$t(1 \leq t\leq 10^5)$$$ — the number of test cases.
Each test case contains two integers k,x(1≤k,x≤3⋅105)$$$k, x (1 \leq k, x \leq 3\cdot10^5)$$$.

f(k,x)=∑y&x=yf(k−1,y)$$$f(k, x) = \sum_{\substack{y \& x = y}} f(k - 1, y)$$$，换句话说，对所有满足 y 是 x$$$x$$$ 的子掩码的 y$$$y$$$，将 f(k−1,y)$$$f(k - 1, y)$$$ 求和，即 (y&x=y)$$$(y \& x = y)$$$。

Monke 试图编写一段代码，计算 f(k,x)$$$f(k, x)$$$ 对 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 取模$$$\bmod$$$ 的结果。当他运行这段代码时，电脑着火了，他失去了理智，于是来找你。现在，为了让他冷静下来(同时证明你比他更聪明)，你需要编写一段代码，计算 f(k,x)$$$f(k, x)$$$ 模 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$ 的结果$$$modulo$$$，且不能烧毁 Monke 的电脑。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含 t(1≤t≤105)$$$t(1 \leq t\leq 10^5)$$$，表示测试用例的数量。
